test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 10 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Fascinating
solution:
The correct answer is- **"Repulsive".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given options, **"Repulsive"** is the most appropriate antonym of **"Fascinating"**.
 
• **Fascinating: **very interesting
 
 
• **Example:** She is such a** fascinating** person.
 
 
 
• **Repulsive: **causing aversion or disgust
 
 
• **Example:** I find political** agendas **to be very repulsive.
 
 
 
• Thus, ***option 4)*** is the correct alternative.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Let us understand the meaning of other options too.

 
• **Unforgettable:** incapable of being forgotten

 
 
• **Example:** The sacrifices of our martyrs for the country is **unforgettable.**
 
 
 
• **Tempting: **appetizing or attractive
 
 
• **Example: **The pizza was so **tempting** that I could not hold myself from eating.
 
 
 
• **Seductive: sexually attractive**
 
 
• **Example: **People frequently remarked on the **seductive** nature of the cult leader.
